title: Updating the middle symbol on a buffer tape
statement: For finite Boolean words $l$ and $m$ and Boolean symbols $a$ and $b$, updating the tape storing the concatenation of $l$, $a$, and $m$ at the integer position $|l|$ to contain $b$ yields exactly the tape storing the concatenation of $l$, $b$, and $m$.
